comparison.objective: Refit, close, and pull-test a loaded drawer on roller slides; candidate removes a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bulky alignment above riding height and slide engagement versus fine internal-feature access and withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer rides, closes, then remains open 30–80 mm after pull-test versus intact reusable terminal extraction. Candidate inspection limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Slide installation and functional pull-testing are meaningfully different from depinning.
